def cache_sim(capacity, ttl, ops):
    from collections import OrderedDict
    
    cache = OrderedDict()  # maps key -> (value, write_time)
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        if op[0] == 'put':
            _, t, key, value = op
            # Remove the key if it already exists (to reorder it)
            if key in cache:
                del cache[key]
            # Add the new entry at the end (most recently used)
            cache[key] = (value, t)
            # Trim cache if over capacity
            while len(cache) > capacity:
                cache.popitem(last=False)  # Remove least recently used (first item)
        
        elif op[0] == 'get':
            _, t, key = op
            # Check if key exists and is not expired
            if key in cache:
                value, write_time = cache[key]
                if write_time + ttl > t:  # Not expired
                    # Move to end (most recently used)
                    del cache[key]
                    cache[key] = (value, write_time)
                    results.append(value)
                else:
                    # Expired, treat as absent
                    del cache[key]
                    results.append(-1)
            else:
                results.append(-1)
    
    return results
